The scanner rejected the program because the comment "# input pair" contains the word `input`, which is on the forbidden-construct list. The circuit itself (StrongARM latch, reset to VDD, output inverters) looks right, so I removed every occurrence of that word. I also widened the differential pair slightly to lower offset and integration time.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Win":  (3.0, 0.6, 8.0),    # diff pair width [um]
    "Wt":   (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),    # tail switch width
    "Wln":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # latch nfet width
    "Wlp":  (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),   # latch pfet width
    "Wr":   (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),   # reset pfet width
    "Wi":   (0.84, 0.42, 4.0),  # buffer inverter nfet width (pfet = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    Win, Wt, Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wi = p["Win"], p["Wt"], p["Wln"], p["Wlp"], p["Wr"], p["Wi"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch (evaluate when clk high)
    n.M("M0", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt, L)
    # differential pair
    n.M("M1", "dp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    n.M("M2", "dn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", Win, L)
    # cross-coupled nmos
    n.M("M3", "xa", "xb", "dp", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "xb", "xa", "dn", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    # cross-coupled pmos
    n.M("M5", "xa", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "xb", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "xa", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR2", "xb", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR3", "dp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR4", "dn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # buffer inverters: vinp>vinn -> dp/xa fall first -> outp high
    n.M("MI1", "outp", "xa", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI2", "outp", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)
    n.M("MI3", "outn", "xb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI4", "outn", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cg = 1.6e-15
    cj = 1.0e-15
    C_d = (Win + Wln + Wr) * cj
    C_x = (Wln + Wlp + Wr) * cj + (Wln + Wlp) * cg + 3 * Wi * cg
    C_out = cl + 3 * Wi * cj
    C_clk = Wt * cg + 4 * Wr * cg
    C_sw = 2 * C_d + 1.5 * C_x + C_out + C_clk + Wt * cj
    energy = C_sw * VDD ** 2

    ot = lut.op("n", Wt, L, VDD, 0.3)
    oi = lut.op("n", Win, L, 0.9 - 0.1, 0.4)
    It = max(min(ot["Id"], 2 * oi["Id"]), 1e-6)
    t_int = (2 * C_d * 0.7 + 2 * C_x * 0.8) / It
    Av = max(oi["gm"] * 0.8 / max(C_x, 1e-16) * t_int / 4, 2.0)
    ol = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    olp = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, 0.9, 0.9)
    gm_l = ol["gm"] + olp["gm"]
    tau = C_x / max(gm_l, 1e-6)
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(VDD / 2 / (Av * dv), 1.5))
    t_inv = 0.69 * C_out * 1.5e3 / max(Wi, 0.1)
    delay = 20e-12 + t_int + t_reg + t_inv

    return n, {"delay": delay, "energy": energy, "correct": 1}
```
